knowledge_gaps: Frequency-bin matching does not isolate lexical similarity: within-bin popularity, text availability and duplicate product variants can still differ. Report balance diagnostics and describe the result as a conditional candidate-set comparison.

Control-pool overlap is unspecified. Allowing lexical items in controls can dilute the comparison; excluding them can make matching infeasible and change the estimand. Predeclare this choice and report overlap and matching coverage.

Reproduction requires fixed frequency-bin boundaries, TF-IDF settings, prefix-text aggregation, user/prefix selection, history truncation, repeated-draw counts, bootstrap configuration and handling of repeated targets already present in histories.
The pseudocode should index B × L × D features by batch and final nonpadding position, add definitions for every new metric, and avoid restarting seed 42 for each control draw.

Training memorization and metadata shortcuts limit generalization. The potential rating of 7 lacks validation evidence; implementation difficulty 4 is plausible only if the existing retrieval and audit infrastructure is reusable. Diagnostic runtime also needs an explicit budget.

The NextItNet reference title is inaccurate and should be checked against arXiv:1808.05163. No supplied evidence establishes that this diagnostic should take priority over a controlled single-model training-sampler experiment.
